description: Java SDK for the Darra PROFINET IO device stack — use a Windows host as a PROFINET IO device under the control of a master system (e.g. a Siemens PLC): RT Class 1 cyclic communication, DCP device discovery/naming/addressing, process-data IO, alarms, diagnostics and I&M records, GSDML import for TIA V15+; real-time frame timing with the Windows x64; the SDK is used in service mode.
